decisions.reason: GA4 is the only Google Analytics standard, so shop clients still need a GA4 tracking plugin and it supports the firm's analytics and conversion services.
Universal Analytics, including the 360 version, was fully shut down in 2024, so the plugin no longer works and maintaining it wastes resources better spent on GA4 and other plugins.
Retail system interfaces are a lasting integration need that uses the firm's interface development skills and ties clients into ongoing support.
Relaunch SEO support connects directly to the firm's core shop relaunch projects, costs little to offer, and is marketed on its own page.
SEO workshops are a recently launched, low-cost consulting product that uses existing marketing expertise and generates leads for larger SEO mandates.
